```{python}
import csv
import json

from IPython.display import HTML, Markdown

from fc_distill.figures import LABELS
from fc_distill.story import HEADLINE, ROOT, Story

story = Story.load()
M = story.methods
splits = {k: len(v) for k, v in json.loads((ROOT / "data" / "splits.json").read_text()).items()}
with open(ROOT / "data" / "audit" / "test_labels.csv") as f:
    audit = list(csv.DictReader(f))


h = story.headline()
serve = story.serving()
verdicts = {v: sum(r["verdict"] == v for r in audit) for v in ("label_ambiguous", "label_wrong")}
defaults_rows = M["defaults"]["B"]["rows"]
teacher = M["teacher"]
last = {k: M["methods"][k]["checkpoints"][-1] for k in M["methods"]}
d_budget = M["at_b_budget"]["D"]
d_cost = next(c for c in M["methods"]["D"]["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == M["methods"]["D"]["selected"])["gpu_hours"]
b_cost = next(c for c in M["methods"]["B"]["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == M["methods"]["B"]["selected"])["gpu_hours"]
b_clean = M["methods"]["B"]["official"]["test-clean"]["exact"]
tie_gap = max(abs(M["methods"][k]["official"]["test-clean"]["exact"] - b_clean) for k in ("C", "D"))


def bfcl_selected(key: str) -> dict:
    m = M["methods"][key]
    return next(c for c in m["checkpoints"] if c["step"] == m["selected"])["bfcl"]


def pct(x: float, digits: int = 1) -> str:
    return f"{100 * x:.{digits}f}%"


def n(x: int) -> str:
    return f"{x:,}"


def wandb(key: str) -> Markdown:
    return Markdown(f"[W&B]({story.facts(key)['wandb']})")


def badge_html(key: str, title: str = "") -> str:
    css = {"B→D": "BD"}.get(key, key)
    tip = f' title="{title}"' if title else ""
    return f'<span class="m m-{css}"{tip}>{LABELS[key]}</span>'


def badge(key: str) -> Markdown:
    """A method's name as a badge in its chart colour, for prose."""
    return Markdown(badge_html(key))


def table(keys: list[str], baselines: bool = False) -> HTML:
    """The results table for `keys`, each at its selected checkpoint; baselines on top if asked."""
    cols = ["Validation", "Test", "Test-clean", "BFCL"]
    head = "".join(f"<th>{c}</th>" for c in ["Method", "Labels", "Step", "GPU-h", *cols])
    rows = []
    if baselines:
        for who, what in (("raw 0.8B", "the student, untrained"), ("raw 2B", "the teacher")):
            scores = [story.score(who, s) for s in ("validation", "test", "test-clean", "bfcl")]
            cells = [f'<span title="{what}">{who}</span>', "", "", "0", *scores]
            rows.append('<tr class="baseline">' + _cells(cells) + "</tr>")
    for k in keys:
        f = story.facts(k)
        cells = [badge_html(k, f["name"]), f["labels"], f["step"], f["gpu_hours"],
                 f["validation"], f["test"], f["test_clean"], f["bfcl"]]
        cls = ' class="headline"' if k == HEADLINE else ""
        rows.append(f"<tr{cls}>" + _cells(cells) + "</tr>")
    return HTML(
        f'<div class="table-scroll"><table class="results"><thead><tr>{head}</tr></thead>'
        f"<tbody>{''.join(rows)}</tbody></table></div>"
    )


def _cells(cells: list[str]) -> str:
    return "".join(f"<td>{c}</td>" for c in cells)
```
